Position:
Instrument & Control System Engineer
Work Location: Sorowako
For National Recruitment

Purpose of the Role
To provide technical support, studies, and project execution related to instrumentation and control systems across all operational areas—including troubleshooting, maintaining performance, implementing optimization initiatives, and executing automation projects—to ensure that operational production performance remains in line with planned targets and that all activities adhere to engineering best practices within the operational areas of PT Vale Indonesia Tbk (PTVI).

Accountabilities:
1. Implement Energy Management, Environment, Health, Safety & Risk (EHSR) standards and regulations by ensuring safety and compliant working conditions, equipment, materials, work methods, employee behaviors, and 5S practices to achieve productivity targets, maintain a clean work environment, and foster a zero harm culture.
2. Provide technical support for Instrumentation & Control systems across various operational departments within PTVI to troubleshoot issues and support operations, maintenance, and project teams during design or upgrade planning phases. Execute instrumentation and control system projects in a time- and cost-efficient manner, optimize workforce utilization, and ensure quality and target achievement.
3. Contribute to the development of junior engineers and maintenance personnel through knowledge-sharing sessions, practical training, and technical presentations.
4. Act as a Design Engineer or Project Engineer in project execution, leading small teams during implementation and delivering projects involving field instrumentation, PLC and HMI programming, and field network configuration, in accordance with PTVI technical standards.
5. Conduct small - to medium - scale automation studies to assess the feasibility of automation improvement initiatives and fulfill FEL (Front-End Loading) 1–3 requirements for capital projects, ensuring safe, timely, cost-effective, and quality-focused execution in accordance with the PTVI
Project Delivery System.
6. Prepare and perform process safety assessments required for projects and assignments, including
Risk Assessments, HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study), JSA (Job Safety Analysis), SWP (Safe Work Procedure), HIRA (Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment), LOPA (Layer of
Protection Analysis), and other relevant studies.
7. Maintain and update PTVI Automation documentation to ensure it remains current and aligned with the implementation of automation systems across PTVI.

8. Conduct problem analysis and incident investigations to identify root causes of undesired events and develop corrective recommendations through technical documentation and reporting for continuous improvement.
9. Implement the annual Automation Safety Program within assigned work areas to prevent incidents and accidents and ensure compliance with the Process Plant Department's safety effectiveness and continuous improvement objectives.
10. Execute the annual personnel development program for assigned automation personnel to achieve competency targets in automation disciplines, support career and succession planning, and maintain up-to-date personal automation expertise to provide effective technical support for process plant management and operations.

Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree (S1) or equivalent in Electrical Engineering with a specialization in Control
Engineering/Control Systems Engineering, or Engineering Physics with a specialization in
Instrumentation Engineering.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in the field of automation and control systems.
• Strong understanding of automation functional descriptions and international control system standards, including those issued by the International Society of Automation (ISA), American
National Standards Institute (ANSI), and other relevant industry standards.
• Strong knowledge of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) systems, including platforms from
Allen-Bradley (AB), Schneider Electric, Siemens, and other major vendors.
• Strong understanding of Process and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&ID), field instrumentation devices, instrument sizing methodologies, control systems, and field device network systems.
• Strong understanding of automation servers, automation control networks, automation applications, and automation system conceptual design.
• Membership in Persatuan Insinyur Indonesia (PII) is preferred.
• Possession of a First Operational Supervisor (POP - Pengawas Operasional Pertama) certification is preferred.
• Preferable have experience or knowledge in the Occupational Health, Safety and Environment
Management System (SMK3L).

Role Purpose

To develop local community relationships and lead community-based on-ground engagement activities that increase Home Business awareness, generate qualified leads, and support subscriber acquisition across FTTH and FWA. The role builds partnerships with residential communities and local stakeholders, drives product education and referral initiatives, and works closely with Circle Sales to convert community engagement into measurable business outcomes.

Scope of Work (SOW)

• Community Mapping & Prioritization — Identify and prioritize residential communities, housing complexes, property managers, resident associations, and local stakeholders based on Home Business market potential and service availability.
• Community Relationship Management — Build and maintain relationships with community leaders, residential management, property developers, and other relevant stakeholders to strengthen market access and engagement.
• On-Ground Activation & Engagement — Plan and execute community-based activations, resident gatherings, door-to-door engagement, product demonstrations, and promotional activities to increase product awareness and consideration.
• Product Education & Consumer Engagement — Communicate the benefits and suitability of FTTH and FWA to residents, helping them understand product options, service availability, and the registration process.
• Lead Generation & Referral Programmes — Develop community-driven lead generation initiatives, referral programmes, and local engagement activities in coordination with Circle Sales to support subscriber acquisition.
• Partnership Development — Establish mutually beneficial partnerships with residential communities, property management, and relevant local organizations to create sustainable acquisition channels.
• Performance Monitoring & Improvement — Track activation results, community participation, qualified leads, referral performance, and subscriber conversion; use insights to improve engagement effectiveness.

Requirements

Education and experience

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, or a related field.
• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in community engagement, field marketing, event activation, partnership development, sales activation, or a related role.
• Experience in telecommunications, property, FMCG, or consumer services is an advantage.
• Experience managing field teams, activation partners, or community stakeholders is preferred.

Functional competencies

• Strong understanding of community engagement and on-ground activation.
• Ability to build relationships with community leaders, property management, and local partners.
• Experience planning events, product demonstrations, and referral or lead-generation programmes.
• Understanding of lead qualification, sales handover, and conversion tracking.
• Ability to monitor activity performance and prepare basic reports.

Behavioural competencies

• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
• Persuasive communication and presentation skills.
• Proactive, hands-on execution and problem-solving.
• Commercial orientation and results-driven mindset.
• Strong coordination skills and adaptability to field-based work.

wo-jpfa-JR5132.d:
PT JAPFA FOOD INDONESIA (WONOAYU)

Job Responsibilities
* Safely operate electric and manual pallet movers, forklifts, and other material handling equipment to transport raw materials and finished goods.
* Load and unload delivery trucks, shipping containers, and storage racks accurately according to shipping manifests and warehouse orders.
* Organize, stack, and store inventory in their designated warehouse locations to maximize space utilization and maintain orderliness.
* Conduct daily pre-operational inspections of the pallet mover equipment and report any maintenance issues or safety hazards to the supervisor immediately.
* Assist with regular inventory counts, stock replenishment, and order picking as required by the logistics team.
* Adhere strictly to PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk's occupational health, safety, and environment (HSE) protocols, as well as food safety standards where applicable.

Job Qualifications
* Proven experience as a Pallet Mover Driver, Forklift Operator, or in a similar warehouse logistics role.
* Must possess a valid heavy equipment operator license or certification (SIO - Surat Izin Operasional) applicable for pallet movers/forklifts.
* Strong understanding of warehouse safety standards, spatial awareness, and safe lifting/stacking procedures.
* Good physical condition with the ability to lift heavy loads and stand for extended periods.
* Disciplined, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Operate production machinery and equipment, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Perform regular maintenance and repairs on equipment to ensure optimal performance.
- Identify and resolve production issues to minimize downtime.
- Ensure adherence to production schedules and standards, maintaining high levels of quality.
- Maintain a clean and safe work environment, following all safety protocols and regulations.
- Assist in the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth production processes.

- Mengoperasikan mesin dan peralatan produksi, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Melakukan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan rutin pada peralatan untuk memastikan kinerja optimal.
- Mengidentifikasi dan memecahkan masalah produksi untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
- Memelihara lingkungan kerja yang bersih dan aman, mengikuti semua protokol dan regulasi keselamatan.
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Berkoordinasi dengan anggota tim lain untuk memastikan proses produksi yang lancar.

Company:
DF PT. Dankos Farma
